module_summary: Destination half of a clearable gray-code CDC FIFO: a pointer child synchronizes the write pointer and produces valid/read index, a data child muxes the async array through a spill register.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid of the destination stream, driven by the data child's spill register.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready accepting words from the destination stream.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Data word read out of the CDC FIFO to the destination domain.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous FIFO storage array from the source side, indexed by the read index.

anchors.name: async_wptr_i
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer from source domain, synchronized for empty detection.

anchors.name: async_rptr_o
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer sent back to the source domain for full detection.

anchors.name: dst_ridx
anchors.why: Binary read index from pointer child selecting the async storage word.

anchors.name: dst_clear_i
anchors.why: Synchronous clear request flushing read pointer and spill register in both children.

anchors.name: dst_valid
anchors.why: Internal not-empty valid from pointer child into the data child's spill register.

anchors.name: dst_ready
anchors.why: Internal ready from data child advancing the read pointer.

groups.name: read_pointer
groups.description: Gray read pointer, write-pointer synchronizer and empty comparison producing valid and read index.

groups.name: read_data_path
groups.description: Muxes async storage by read index and buffers the word in a spill register to the output.
